Great article! I saw a lot of lived streamed acts and this year was the best so far since they have lived streamed Coachella 2010.

  • Best night set: Florence and the Machine: She went into the crowd at least 5 times. While singing. And barefoot. She defines Coachella. Her voice was in top condition.
  • Best Day Set: I'm going to say Kimbra as she has this quirky way about her. She is like a sweet St. Vincent. Weird but at least I get her lyrics
  • Best WTF: FKA Twigs. I'm not sure how to describe her music but her live set, -- one had to strain to hear her voice over a very pulsating bass. Her movements are very fluidic. Opposite of a St. Vincent set were they are very robotic.
  • Best New Artist: LIGHTS: So much fun with this band. They wanted to be there. Lead singer is hot and lyrically fun. Need more.
  • Best Surprise: Clean Bandit with Marina and the Diamonds. I want more of this type of collaboration. I love Marina! And I missed her set. :(

The rest of what I saw were bits of pieces of other groups and most of the EDM acts. I can say that the worst act was some guy just using his laptop and creating weird images and sounds. I didn't get it. I didn't care. The building of the Snail was much more interesting. ^.^
